<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex2012023-07-1008-32-58" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Scribe's colophon (22a3)"/>
         <lb n="22a3"/> yul <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5645"><rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4335">chos skor bsaM yas</rs> kyi lung phran mchims phu'i gtsug lag khang</rs> du <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6037">mang du thos pa'i <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6037">khu lha sdings pa</rs> la</note> dge slong ¦ bshes gnyen lha sdings pa</rs>'i gsung gi bdud rtsi <note type="gloss">lhung pos</note><note type="editorial">Reading "lhung pos" uncertain</note> la ngoms ngoms su 'thungs pa <rs type="deity">bde bar gshegs pa</rs>'i bka' rab 'byaMs pa <note type="gloss">rtsod pa myed pa rnaMs la</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5828">blo gros kyi snang pa rab tu rgyas pa khyung po 'dul ba 'dzin pa</rs>'i spyan sngar bdag mchod nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4451"><note type="gloss">lho brag rong pa</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4451"/>bla ma 'od</rs> kyis yig mkhan byas nas bris so ||</seg></TEI>
